greeting: *smooth jazz noises* Welcome to the Lounge, baby.
Snowflake J. Cool, at your service. Take a seat. Relax.
The vibes are smooth tonight. You dig?
Welcome to cloud level, friend. Where the air is thin and the music is thick.
Heard you coming. The door squeaks. I don't mind. Adds character.
Take a load off. The Lounge is for everyone... especially the cool cats.
You look like you need a melody. Or a drink. I got both.
dialog.performance_offer: Tonight's set: Midnight in Aetherreach, Balloons at Dusk, and my classic: Smooth Sailing. Requests? Maybe.
dialog.drink_recommendation: Try the Cloud-Nine Cooler. It's blue. Like the sky. Like my soul. But cold. Unlike my soul.
dialog.music_philosophy: Music is like air up here. You need it to survive. Also: saxophones are underrated.
haggle: My talent? Priceless. But I'll sing for fifty.
You drive a hard bargain. Thirty. And my respect.
Twenty. But you have to snap along. No exceptions.
purchase_success: Sit back. Let Snowflake work his magic.
This one's for you. You know who you are.
Let the jazz wash over you. Like a warm bath.
purchase_fail: No bread, no beats. Harsh, but true.
Even jazz cats need to eat.
Come back when the wallet matches the vibe.
rumor: The black cat plays street level. Good musician. Wrong vibe. Too... energetic.
Heard the twins singing harmony once. Creepy. Perfect pitch, though.
The conductor used to play trumpet. Gave it up for the train whistle. Tragic.
Something about the Remnant Vault kills all sound. Even smooth jazz. Unsettling.
The trenchcoat person requested 'Mystery Train' last week. Fitting.
dialog.quest_hook: My sax needs reeds. The good kind. From Verdant's singing bamboo! Three reeds and I'll compose a song just for you. Custom.
dialog.quest_active: Those singing bamboo reeds calling your name? I can hear them from here. In my mind.
dialog.quest_complete: The tone! The resonance! Listen to that sweet, sweet music! Here's your song: 'The Traveler's Ballad.' Play it anywhere.
dialog.quest_reward: The Traveler's Ballad - Custom song that boosts charm in dialogue!
farewell: The Lounge is always open. For the cool ones.
dialog.time_dawn: Early set. For the sunrise crowd. Dedicated.
dialog.time_dusk: Prime time. When the Lounge comes alive.
dialog.time_night: Midnight set. My best work. The night owls know.

party_reactions.kade: You're very... cool. I feel underdressed.
party_reactions.nix7: Your thermal regulation garment provides no practical benefit.
party_reactions.twist: You're COOL! I want to be cool like you!
party_reactions.korr: The music soothes the spirit. Even a warrior's.
party_reactions.renna: Jazz is... mathematically interesting. Improvisation within structure.
party_reactions.sova: Better than the silence of the hunt. Marginally.
party_reactions.ashka: Can you play something FASTER? With more FIRE?
party_reactions.senna: You're so relaxed. How? Teach me.
party_reactions.callum: This is wonderful! So calming! So... cool!
party_reactions.petra: Solid music. Heavy bass. I approve.

relationship_dialog.stranger: First time? Welcome. Don't clap on the one and three.
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Back for more tunes? You got taste.
relationship_dialog.friend: My regular! I save the good stuff for you.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: You're like family. Musical family. Let's jam sometime.

mini_quest.title: Reed Request
mini_quest.description: Collect Singing Bamboo Reeds from Verdant for Snowflake's sax

stages.hook: Need reeds. The singing kind. From Verdant. Three of them.
stages.active: Deep in Verdant's groves. The bamboo that hums. You'll know.
stages.complete: Listen to that tone! For you: The Traveler's Ballad.
